about: The presets of chapter 12.1 as built-in rule sets. They are Suggested (Appendix D #16 and #69). Each lists every setting its row names, even where the default already has that value, so the preset still holds if a layer between the default and the rule set changes it.

ruleSets.name: Casual
ruleSets.description: Digital rolls only and no approvals, easy enemy AI, no money penalty when you white out, fog of war off.

ruleSets.name: Hardcore
ruleSets.description: Physical rolls with approvals, 60-second turn timer, death saves, 50 % money loss, hard AI, bosses 1 in 30, healers cost ₽100.

ruleSets.name: At the table
ruleSets.description: Physical cards, player-submitted rolls with approval, no digital rolls.

ruleSets.name: Remote
ruleSets.description: Digital rolls allowed with approvals for typed ones, turn timer 120 s, push notifications on.
